title: The Playground
hook: 在游乐场，乔治怕高，佩奇卡在轮胎里，猪爸爸坐滑梯卡住了，大家笑成一团。

cells.a: They are at the playground with all their friends.
cells.cn: 他们和朋友们在游乐场。

cells.q: What did Peppa want to do?
cells.a: She wanted to push George on the swing.
He does not like being up high on the swing.
cells.cn: 他不喜欢在秋千上被荡得那么高。

cells.q: What did Peppa say to the others?
cells.a: She said, “You are doing it all wrong!”
She got stuck in the tyre and could not get out.
cells.cn: 她卡在轮胎里出不来了。

cells.a: She asked if he wants to play on the climbing frame.
cells.cn: 她问乔治要不要去玩攀爬架。

cells.q: What is Peppa doing on the climbing frame?
cells.a: She is swinging across and calling her parents to look.
cells.cn: 她在攀爬架上荡过去，还喊爸妈看她。

cells.q: Why can't Daddy Pig go down the slide?
cells.a: Because he is too big for the little slide.
cells.cn: 因为小滑梯装不下他这么大的人。

cells.q: What did everyone think when Daddy slid down?
cells.a: They laughed, and even Daddy says it is a bit funny.
cells.cn: 大家都笑了，连爸爸自己都说有点好笑。

ending: In the end, Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide. My favourite part is ______.
